<cite ref="Berakhot 28a">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> top <he>מַן י׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כסא דמוקרא</he>, Ms. F. <cite ref="D00650"><he>דִּיקָרָא</he></cite>) a vessel of honor (precious vessel).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:20">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>הספידא י׳ וכ׳</he> are funeral ceremonies (eulogies, wailings &c.) for the honor of the deceased or of the survivors? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>הנהו בני י׳ נינהו</he> were those (the survivors of the house of Jeroboam) worthy of honors?—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>לית היא עבדא לִיקָרָךְ</he> she acts (treats thee) not according to thy dignity; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:3">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>לִיקַרְתָּךְ</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Ib.</cite> <he>דליתה מִיְּקָרָךְ</he> for she is not (part) of thy dignity, i.e. not worthy of thee; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665:10">Yalk. Lev. 665</cite> <he>דלית היא יקרך</he>, a. <he>דיקרך</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite> <he>דיק׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 11:3:3">Y. Keth. XI, 34ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דאִיקְרָךְ</he>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:4">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה תבע בִּיקָרֵיה</he> the Lord takes up the cause of his offended dignity; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יִקְרַיָּא</he>.
